values.summary: Build and measure one disposable Rust construction slice that proves the four-layer architecture, fake-adapter discipline, recovery journey, dependency choices, and all ten quantitative thresholds before production construction.

steps.action: Verify V3-01 is terminal and materialize the exact pinned dependency, cargo-deny, jq, template, capability-matrix, and source-baseline inputs.
Build a one-binary/one-library spike with pure domain, application services, narrow adapters, command orchestration, and deterministic fakes.
Prototype the full exact-review recovery journey and prove semantic correction, projection regeneration, audit readback, and fresh review without direct state edits.
Classify every GitHub operation and prototype Linux, macOS, and Windows commit primitives without issuing Decision 11.
Measure all ten frozen thresholds, dependency counts, object safety, implementation lines, and clean/warm behavior using producer receipts.
Produce a promote-or-discard disposition; stop before V3-03 on any missing or failed threshold, real-state mutation, or unresolved dependency choice.
Terminate every spike process, remove disposable build output while preserving measured receipts, and prove that no real C-SDLC record or remote resource changed.

invariants: Issue V3-02 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: A passing artifact could overstate production, legal, or release authority.
Path or external-account overlap could collide with another active issue.
Evidence could become stale if it is not tied to exact revisions and producer outcomes.
stop_conditions: The slice requires ADL product crates, cannot isolate the domain from async/adapters, exceeds approved thresholds without disposition, mutates real C-SDLC state, or cannot complete the recovered-correction journey from the frozen capability matrix. Any stop condition blocks V3-03 rather than being accepted as construction-spike paperwork.
